description: This file defines the LeaveDuration class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It models leave durations, including full-day, half-day (morning/afternoon), and specify time, with validation and utility methods.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: Class representing the duration of a leave, supporting different types such as full day, half day, or specific times, with validation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveDuration object with a specified type and optional start/end times.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the leave duration type, validating against allowed types.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Returns the start time if the type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setFromTime
methods.description: Sets the start time; only valid for 'specify_time' type.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Returns the end time if the type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end time; only valid for 'specify_time' type, and must be after fromTime.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is half day morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is half day afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the leave type specifies exact times.
